title: HIVE Digital Secures $220M Sovereign AI GPU Deal With Bell Canada
summary: HIVE Digital has partnered with Bell Canada and Cohere in a $220 million deal to deploy sovereign Nvidia Blackwell GPUs for enterprise AI compute.

title: Kentucky Attorney General Sues Polymarket And Kalshi Over Sports Betting Claims
summary: Kentucky Attorney General Russell Coleman has filed lawsuits against Polymarket, Kalshi, and Coinbase-linked prediction market activity, alleging unlicensed sports betting.

title: Ethereum Glamsterdam Upgrade Moves Toward 200M Gas Limit Roadmap
summary: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade roadmap is advancing through devnet work, with ePBS and block-level access lists central to a potential 200 million gas limit path.

title: Alchemy AgentCard Brings Visa Payments To AI Agent Commerce
summary: Alchemy’s AgentCard gives AI agents a virtual payment layer with spending controls, identity tools and support for emerging machine-payment standards.

title: Ethereum EIP-8304 Proposal Targets Trustless Log And Transaction Indexing
summary: Ethereum developers are discussing EIP-8304, a draft proposal for trustless log and transaction indexing that could reduce reliance on centralized indexers.

title: Trace Finance Raises $32M To Expand Stablecoin Settlement Rails
summary: Trace Finance has raised $32 million to expand regulated stablecoin settlement infrastructure across Brazil, the US and other emerging markets.

title: SEC Proposes Scrapping Reg NMS Trade-Through Rule In Move To Ease Market Complexity
summary: The SEC has proposed rescinding Regulation NMS Rule 611 and Rule 610(e), a move that could reshape US market structure and alternative trading competition.

title: Ethereum Proposal Targets Safer AI-Agent Wallets With Asset-Level Spending Limits
summary: Ethereum developers are discussing an asset-enforced spend mandate that could place wallet and AI-agent spending limits directly at the token level.

title: CME Plans CFTC Lawsuit Over Perpetual Futures Approval
summary: CME Group is preparing to sue the CFTC over perpetual futures approvals, escalating a fight over crypto derivatives and retail trading rules.

title: Coinbase-Backed Satori Finance Says It Will Wind Down Operations
summary: Satori Finance says it will wind down by July 16, citing unfavorable market conditions and unsustainable revenues for its derivatives platform.
